summaryText:
Hi,

Here is the end-of-day summary for 7 September 2026.
Total work logged: 8h 25m.

Tickets worked on today:

AEME-6282 — [For approval] Redeem rewards on impacted orders
  Customers exploited multi-tab checkout to redeem and cancel rewards points on 22 UAE orders. 18 remediated via PC-48490. 4 remain with insufficient GCRM balance — partial redemption script prepared under PC-53503. (1h 45m)

AEME-6499 — 
  5 UAE stuck orders investigated. 4 progressed to COMPLETED. 1 order (AE260812-57849665) remains at SHIPPING_REQUESTED after color swap and partial cancellation failure. Parallel DB, Kibana, and codebase traces launched. (25m)

AEME-6500 — 
  5 UAE orders investigated. 3 resolved (stock updated, PC-52918 remediation, shipping address fixed). 2 remain stuck at SHIPPING_REQUESTED — one awaiting warehouse shipment, one with SMC UPDATE_ERROR pending PC-53305 approval. (1h 0m)

AEME-6535 — 
  SUBS team requested 18 new SubscriptionData columns for the UAE PROD Daily SC+ Report. Groovy script created under PC-53535 adding columns U-AL. PC-53535 reviewed by Vaibhav Jain, awaits HAC scripting console execution. (25m)

AEME-6540 — [PROD] | Manual Chargeback || 07-Sep
  Two UAE trade-in clawback chargebacks triggered automatically but Checkout.com declined both card authorizations. Orders are COMPLETED. Awaiting customer card update confirmation to re-trigger clawback via Backoffice or Groovy script.

PC-5 — 

PC-53305 — 
  Reusable PC ticket for SMC re-registration remediation on order AE260819-63130115. Script resets ExternalService ERROR to NEW and retriggers consignment process. Approved-ES status. Blocked by parent AEME-6500.

PC-53535 — 
  Modifies UAE PROD Daily SC+ Report to add 18 SubscriptionData columns (U-AL). Script updates gcc-PROD-Daily-SC-ReportScript via HAC. Reviewed by Vaibhav Jain. Rollback: revert to script version 44. (25m)

PC-53689 — Add Affiliate_Name and Multistore_VerificationCode columns to SA Sales Report
  Adds Affiliate_Name and Multistore_VerificationCode columns to SA Sales Report. Updated SaSalesReport.groovy attached. No build needed — Groovy loaded dynamically. Awaits upload to Hybris script repository and manual cronjob verification. (1h 0m)

SAME-3960 — 
  SA screen repair order — return blocked because GCIC service order status is beyond cancellable window ST030. Hybris correctly blocks return per business logic. Options: contact GCIC for manual status change or enable config bypass. (2h 30m)

TKME-2308 — 
  17 TR-region stuck orders investigated. 5 already resolved. 12 remain across 5 root causes: FI connection errors (5), GetMobil NPE (2), refund failures (2), WMS blocks (2), and return shipping (1). No reusable PC tickets found. (20m)

TKME-2311 — 
  Master data creation for TR store C750_007_31536 (Antalya). ImpEx follows same pattern as 8 prior tickets. PC-53498 carries the script. Reviewed and approved. Reporter confirmed successful creation with minor backoffice adjustments. (35m)

Open tickets:

PC-53689 [Approved-ES] — Add Affiliate_Name and Multistore_VerificationCode columns to SA Sales Report
  Todo: Approved by D2C
Please validate in production, then update the comments and also monitor the performance impact as well.

AEME-6282 [In Progress] — [For approval] Redeem rewards on impacted orders
  Todo: Hi ~@email ,

 

According to the API details, the requested amount exceeds the customer's current balance.

The custome

PC-53503 [To do] — Redeem rewards points (partial) for 4 AE orders - AEME-6282
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

SAME-3958 [QA Server Review] — Sales Report - Additional Columns
  Todo: Awaiting QA review.

PC-53529 [To do] — [SAM-24720] Create DB cleanup cronjobs for SMI cluster
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

AEME-6540 [In Progress] — [PROD] | Manual Chargeback || 07-Sep
  Todo: Continue investigation.

SAM-24720 [Code Review] —  Update or create Cronjob for autocleanup
  Todo: Hi ~@email,
   Please find below details : 
SAP incident : https://me.sap.com/cases/002075129500011086542026/overview
Sa

Thanks,
Aryan
